Subject: Request: short-term reclassification & burst pricing for committed A800s

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for taking our call yesterday. Short version: we have an urgent availability issue in our HPC cluster that will delay onboarding of a portion of our inference footprint for 6–8 weeks. We have a 24-month Dedicated commitment for 120 A800 units beginning Oct 1 (see attached profile).

As a temporary mitigation we want to:
- Reclassify 48 of the A800s (40% of committed) to A600 for a 90-day window (we validated parity for our quantized models)
- Have a reservation hold on the 48 units so they do not auto-fail to on-demand while we complete the migration
- Obtain a one-time overage discount of 25% for burst consumption on top of baseline while reclassification is in effect (cap: up to 50% of baseline per month)

Business reason: avoids a hard cutoff for customers mid-migration, preserves cost predictability, and lets us keep our launch timeline. We can sign an amendment for the temporary change + an acceptance test within 30 days.

Attachments: Auriga_capacity_profile.csv (run traces + baseline), brief notes on perf.

Can you confirm next steps and who needs to sign off? Time is tight — procurement asked for a written confirmation by EOW.

Best,
Ellen Park
Head of ML Ops, AurigaMed

Vivek — ran the numbers with billing. Summary below (high level):

Scenario A — customer request (90 days + 25% burst discount, reservation hold):
- Expected gross revenue hold (no change to committed ARR): $2.1M
- Incremental cost to Redwood for burst headroom (GPU hours at preferred capacity): ~$42k/month
- Billing exposure if unlimited bursts: high; we suggest a cap (customer proposed 50% of baseline/month)
- Net margin impact over 90 days: ~4.5% reduction vs baseline

Scenario B — our recommended concession (60 days + 20% burst discount + reservation hold):
- Incremental cost: ~$28k/month
- Net margin impact over 60 days: ~2.8% reduction
- Operational note: 60-day window reduces exposure and preserves runway for capacity reallocation

Other operational asks:
- Require signed amendment + acceptance test within 30 days (amendment draft attached)
- Cap overage discount to bursts up to 50% of baseline and to total increased usage of 1.5x baseline
- One-time waiver of early-termination fee for the 48-unit sub-bundle during the migration window

I've attached a draft amendment (Auriga_amendment_draft.pdf) and linked HubSpot deal (see related links). If you want to escalate to Exec for the full 25%/90-day ask, highlight the business rationale; otherwise recommend approving Scenario B.

— Karthik
Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear analysis. I will approve a constrained concession to keep the customer on track but with guardrails. Approve the following (final):

- Approve Scenario B as proposed by Deal Desk: 60-day reclassification A800 -> A600 for 40% of committed units (48 units)
- Approve reservation hold on the 48 units for the 60-day window (prevents auto-fail to on-demand)
- Approve a 20% one-time overage discount on burst usage, capped at up to 50% of baseline per month and no more than 1.5x baseline in total during the window
- Approve a one-time waiver of the early-termination fee for the 48-unit sub-bundle during the hold window

Conditions:
1) Customer signs the amendment and completes the acceptance test within 30 days of amendment execution
